description:
Sandrone , also known by her codename " Marionette ," is an upcoming playable Cryo character in Genshin Impact .

She is the Seventh of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers and a member of the Adventurers' Guild .

She was created by Alain Guillotin in the image of his deceased sister, Mary-Ann Guillotin , and keeps Pulonia , his final creation, as her constant companion following Guillotin's death.
